detail: C11 (condition-11 unit-artifact manifest, Option B) is FIXED locally with CI wiring. DIAGNOSIS: the producer already existed (tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py) but shipped unwired and UNWRITABLE — its v1 derivation walked every receipt under receipts/adversarial/audit and failed closed on the first of ~90 receipts naming never-committed probe outputs (measured: command-center/p2-next/C11-MISSING-ARTIFACTS.json), so command-center/UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json could never exist while 44 receipts already pointed at it (AUD-0095 records this as the sibling BLD-0001 issue). The owner-decision doc's "80 receipts" was stale: fresh census measured 20 old-path (the 2026-08-16 p2-wave already moved 361 receipts to per-probe manifests). FIX: (1) producer rewritten to a CLOSED REGISTRATION CONTRACT — derives only from receipts whose manifest_registration.manifest_path names this manifest; FATAL on empty walk, unreadable claimer, a registered=true claim naming an absent artifact, or zero-registrable corpus; non-claiming ghost-namers are disclosed in an explicit unregistrable block (green by disclosure, never silence); restored the scratch-tree exclusion that a drift in my own run proved was missing (receipt-validate self-test mutants in p2-wave/_r2_tmp leaked into the contract); 7-case both-states self-test. (2) Manifest now exists on disk: 50 claimers, 48 units, 58 artifact rows hashed CRLF-to-LF, 5 unregistrable claimers disclosed with exact missing paths (AUD-0006, CC-0011, REL-0001, TST-0129, RES-0164 — all registered=false). (3) Migration script repointed the 6 REAL old-path receipts (ADV-0026, ADV-0032, casualty ADV-0021/ADV-0022, TST-0334, TST-0350) byte-surgically with structural verification and reversibility check; the other 14 old-path files are frozen both-states fixtures under p2-wave/fixtures/ consumed by ready_units.py/unitgate.py (AUD-0095 freeze inventory) and are deliberately untouched; idempotent re-run migrates 0. (4) CI wired via a NEW workflow .github/workflows/unit-artifact-manifest.yml (self-test then --check), the repo-sanctioned separate-file shape (quality.yml is a closed charter set policed by charter_check.sh; no sibling-file conflicts). (5) Red proof on the live tree recorded in C11-REDPROOF.json. NO state field and NO registered flag was flipped anywhere — the 7 reviewed units stay BLOCKED as the owner decision requires. LOCAL-GREEN SUFFICIENCY: the gate is stdlib-only and fully local (no network/containers); CI runs the identical two commands on ubuntu. Caveat for the orchestrator: CI checks COMMITTED state, so the commit MUST include the new manifest together with the 6 migrated receipts and the producer, and --write must be re-run if receipts/artifacts change again before commit. During my run a sibling lane concurrently modified command-center/p2-next/REVIEW-GATE-SPLIT.json and VENDOR-SATISFIABILITY.json — those diffs are NOT mine; my producer --check stayed green across them because they are neither claimers nor registered artifacts.
evidence: BEFORE (failing gate, exact error): python tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --check -> rc=1 'FAILED:unit-manifest receipt command-center/receipts/AUD-0006.json names absent artifact command-center/p2-wave/probes/AUD-0006/probe2-classified-2026-08-16.json' (v1 producer; manifest absent on disk while 44 receipts pointed at it)
AFTER (same command): rc=0 'SUCCESS:unit-manifest command-center/UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json matches derived claimer corpus (closed registration contract)'

Self-test: rc=0 'SUCCESS:unit-manifest-self-test green on clean, red on drift, fatal on registered-ghost, disclosed on unregistered-ghost, closed on empty walk, closed on zero-registrable, ignored other-manifest receipts' (includes the new T5 scratch-leak discriminator asserting the empty-walk message, not the fatal rule)

Both-states red proof on the LIVE tree (command-center/p2-next/C11-REDPROOF.json, disk-verified, artifact restored hash-identically): R1_drift_red rc=1 'drift'; R1_restore_green rc=0; G1_gate_good 'SATISFIED: registered in command-center/UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json' via receipt_schema_gate.evaluate_gate_a with verify_filesystem=True at repo root; G2_gate_bad 'UNSATISFIED: manifest absent on disk' in a root without the manifest

Cross-consumer proof (command-center/p2-next/_c11_crossconsumer.py): completion_predicate._c11_manifest (the STRONG membership+digest consumer) scores SATISFIED on a registered=true row and UNSATISFIED 'not registered ... (ARC-0084)' against an empty manifest — digests in the manifest match its expectations

Migration receipt: 'SUCCESS:c11-migrate migrated=6 skipped_fixtures=14 remaining_old_path=0 (of real receipts)'; idempotent re-run 'migrated=0'; each file verified parse-delta==manifest_path only + byte-reversible

Regression greens: python command-center/receipt_validate.py --self-test -> 1 golden ACCEPTED, 4 mutants REJECTED (TST-0334 migration did not break admission); python -m pytest platform/lib/test_receipt_schema_gate.py -q -> 59 passed; platform/lib/test_completion_predicate.py -q -> 65 passed; uvx ruff@0.15.17 check on all touched .py -> All checks passed; .github/workflows/unit-artifact-manifest.yml parses via pyyaml with 4 steps (pinned checkout/setup-python SHAs copied from p2next-rail-count.yml)

Drift-detector control on the real triggering input: after re-running receipt_validate --self-test (which recreates selftest-m1/m2/m3 mutants in p2-wave/_r2_tmp), unit_manifest --check stays rc=0 — the scratch exclusion is proven against the input that exposed the omission, not only the synthetic self-test case

Corpus censuses on disk: command-center/p2-next/C11-CENSUS.json (425 receipt-shaped files with manifest_registration; 20 old-path, 44 top-level-new, 361 probe-local at lane start) and C11-MISSING-ARTIFACTS.json (90 receipts name absent artifacts corpus-wide — why the v1 all-receipts derivation could never produce the file)
item: C11 — Condition 11 Option B: unit-artifact manifest producer (PR #325, branch pr-325)
open_questions: Commit coupling (orchestrator action): the new .github/workflows/unit-artifact-manifest.yml runs --check against the COMMITTED tree, so the commit must bundle tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py + command-center/UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json + the 6 migrated receipts together; if any receipt or registered artifact changes again before commit, re-run `python tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write` and include the regenerated manifest, else CI will correctly fail on drift.

Concurrent sibling edits observed in command-center/p2-next/ (REVIEW-GATE-SPLIT.json, VENDOR-SATISFIABILITY.json modified during my run — not by me); the rail-count lane's published numbers re-derive from the committed tree and may need one more refresh after this lands.

5 unregistrable claimers are disclosed in the manifest (AUD-0006, CC-0011, REL-0001, TST-0129, RES-0164): their receipts name probe artifacts that were never committed (AUD-0006's undated counterparts DO exist on disk if its lane ever wants to repair the dated paths). All five carry registered=false, so nothing claimed is un-honored; repair or leave disclosed is those lanes' call.

The 14 frozen fixtures under p2-wave/fixtures/ still declare the charter manifest path (deliberate: AUD-0095 freeze inventory; ready_units.py/unitgate.py controls). If the owner later wants them on the unit manifest, the migration script's EXCLUDED_FIXTURE_DIR constant is the single switch.

Zero live-CI run yet (no push happened from this lane; commits are orchestrator-only): local parity is exact (same two commands, stdlib-only) and the workflow mirrors p2next-rail-count.yml's pinned-action shape, but the first real CI execution remains to be observed.
test_results: Local gate sequence, all disk-verified: producer --self-test rc=0 (7 control groups, 9 cases); --write rc=0 (58 rows / 50 claimers / 5 unregistrable disclosed); --check rc=0; migration rc=0 (6 migrated, 14 frozen fixtures skipped) and idempotent; red proof rc=0 (C11-REDPROOF.json: drift-red, restore-green hash-identical, gate SATISFIED good-state, gate UNSATISFIED absent-manifest bad-state); cross-consumer probe rc=0 (strong predicate SATISFIED/UNSATISFIED both states); regression: receipt_validate --self-test rc=0, platform/lib/test_receipt_schema_gate.py 59 passed, platform/lib/test_completion_predicate.py 65 passed, ruff 0.15.17 clean on all touched .py files. Failing-state capture before the fix: --check rc=1 (absent-artifact fail-closed on AUD-0006), manifest absent on disk.
